Checkpoint and Catalog Persistence
|-- Record model: immutable content behind mutable references
|   |-- canvasCheckpointRecords.ts -> lossless checkpoint encoding
|   |   |-- Split independently edited objects into path-keyed records
|   |   |   `-- Parent skeleton retains ordering; restore fills validated placeholders
|   |   |-- SHA-256(JSON) identifies canvas-value and canvas-text items
|   |   |   `-- sourceAscii and strings >= 512 characters become reusable text items
|   |   |-- Checkpoint = logical ID + parent/transaction IDs + record diff
|   |   |   |-- added / updated [old, new] / removed references
|   |   |   |-- Parent delta depth < 31 -> use parent as base
|   |   |   `-- Otherwise -> depth 0 with full reference map; retain history parent
|   |   `-- checkpointHead = head ID + complete reference map for direct reads
|   `-- workspaceRecords.ts -> workspace index + document/<encoded ID>/ records
|       |-- Mutable: metadata, baseline, canvas view, viewport, history header
|       |-- Immutable content: item/<hash>, revision/<ID>, checkpoint/<ID>
|       |   `-- Checkpoint semantics stay fixed; encoding and transaction links may change
|       `-- Workspace index: document IDs, active document, cross-canvas transfers
|-- Browser changes -> incremental batches
|   |-- WorkspacePersistence: live sessions + source-pane view
|   |   |-- Per-session cursor requests only history changes since last sync
|   |   |-- Add metadata, baseline, encoded view and changed viewport
|   |   |-- Import/reset removes obsolete checkpoint and revision keys in the same batch
|   |   `-- Deduplicate keys; send shared content-addressed items only once
|   `-- RecordStorage: synchronous local cache -> queued transport
|       |-- Skip equal values; coalesce pending changes by key
|       |-- Default debounce 150 ms; scheduling caps pending delay at 1 second
|       |-- One in-flight batch: requestId + expectedRevision + changes
|       |   |-- Acknowledged -> advance revision and persisted sequence
|       |   `-- Failed -> retain identical batch and request ID
|       |       |-- Automatic retry uses exponential backoff, capped at 30 seconds
|       |       `-- REJECTED / VERSION_CONFLICT / REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT stop scheduling
|       `-- Explicit commit: flush earlier writes -> submit -> await acknowledgement
|           |-- REJECTED -> restore prior cache and discard abandoned operation
|           `-- Ambiguous failure -> retry same request before allowing another write
|-- Server batch acceptance -> one workspace publication boundary
|   `-- WorkspaceRecordStore.apply() [serialized per store root]
|       |-- Check request identity before checking expectedRevision
|       |   |-- Recorded ID + same batch hash -> return original revision
|       |   |-- Recorded ID + different hash -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       |   `-- New ID + stale revision -> VERSION_CONFLICT
|       |-- Apply changes to a candidate record map
|       |   |-- Reject duplicate keys and changed immutable revisions/items
|       |   `-- Re-encoded checkpoints must restore to the same semantic content
|       |-- validateRecordUpdate()
|       |   |-- Check project, document index, keys, required records and item hashes
|       |   |-- Validate affected history and current document composition
|       |   |   `-- History removal requires broader validation
|       |   `-- Validate transfer participants, before/after checkpoints and transaction links
|       `-- Publish backing blobs BEFORE workspace-records.json
|           |-- Hash each changed record -> workspace-records/<hash>.json
|           |-- Up to 8 writers; await every writer, including on failure
|           |-- Sync blob files and directory before publishing references
|           `-- Atomically replace manifest with references + new revision + retry receipt
|               |-- Batch becomes reachable together, including multi-canvas changes
|               `-- Uncertain publication outcome -> retry same ID to discover receipt
|-- Published canvases -> separate catalog boundary
|   `-- CanvasCatalogStore [serialized catalog operations]
|       |-- publishCheckpoint()
|       |   |-- Matching request signature -> return prior receipt
|       |   |-- Check expected published revision and repository ownership
|       |   |-- WorkspaceRecordStore.capture() pins one manifest
|       |   |   |-- Require saved head ID and metadata version to match request
|       |   |   `-- Hydrate selected checkpoint + exact bound revisions; retain archive refs
|       |   `-- Publish existing autosave references + checkpoint receipt in catalog.json
|       |       `-- Old catalog revisions need no hydration
|       |-- acceptCanvasChanges()
|       |   |-- Retry receipt keyed by change session; require same request and session version
|       |   |-- Require distinct documents/targets and expected current revisions
|       |   |-- Fork new histories or adopt proposals into existing histories
|       |   `-- Persist backing records -> atomically replace catalog once
|       |       `-- All new heads + before/after acceptance receipt become visible together
|       |-- publishOutputPromotion() -> canvases + group membership + receipt in one write
|       `-- Archive -> metadata-only catalog update; preserve encoded history references
|-- Restore only what the caller needs
|   |-- loadCanvasCheckpoint()
|   |   |-- Supplied head reference map -> direct item loading
|   |   |-- Otherwise -> bounded base-chain replay, at most 31 delta links
|   |   `-- Verify item hashes; reject invalid chains, conflicting diffs and missing values
|   |-- DiagramPersistence.currentHistory()
|   |   |-- Load head + exact bound diagram revisions; preserve logical IDs
|   |   |-- Return single-checkpoint baseline with empty past/future
|   |   `-- Saved or recording canvas views -> retain full graph via restore('current')
|   |-- Full restore -> rebuild checkpoints, validate history, restore revision registry
|   |   `-- Accepted immutable objects can reuse previously expanded snapshots
|   |-- Workspace viewHeaders() -> index + metadata + history headers only
|   `-- Source bindings / acceptance receipts -> targeted reads without restoring undo history
`-- Storage adapters and durability
    |-- DiagramPersistence: validated portable documents <-> stored record references
    |   |-- Persist diagrams, revisions, checkpoint items and archive references
    |   `-- Public transports/exports remain expanded portable documents
    |-- DiagramRevisionStore: SHA-256 records, checked on read and existing-content reuse
    |   |-- diagrams/<kind>/<hash>.json for diagram, revision and history records
    |   |-- workspace-records/<hash>.json for captured workspace references
    |   `-- Temporary file -> rename; catalog references publish after writes finish
    `-- ImmutableRecords: reusable content-addressed blob store
        |-- Verify hashes on disk reads; cache bounded to 256 entries / 32 MiB
        `-- publishJson(): write temporary file -> fsync -> rename -> fsync directory
